annotation.title_clean: Iniciativa con proyecto de decreto por el que se expide la Ley Federal para el Desarrollo Ético, Soberano e Inclusivo de la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Initiative with draft decree issuing the Federal Law for the Ethical, Sovereign and Inclusive Development of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Cámara de Diputados, LXVI Legislatura (MORENA and PVEM deputies; Gaceta Parlamentaria)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Mexican legislative initiative (April 2025) by MORENA and PVEM deputies proposing a comprehensive federal AI law in 29 chapters: risk traffic-light classification, a National AI Council, rights and duties, sanctions, sandboxes, sustainability, and strict liability for high-risk systems. No robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates a National AI Council and a risk 'traffic light' classification system
Strict (objective) liability for harm caused by high-risk AI systems, with joint liability among multiple actors
Bans fully automated decisions without human intervention in health, justice, education, security, finance and labor when rights are significantly affected
Mandatory incident response protocol with technical report to authority within 72 hours; precautionary suspension
Regulatory sandboxes, a digital sustainability chapter, and protection of children and vulnerable groups
